Type: ceramic planter with wood stand
Use: holding an indoor plant; on the floor beside a sofa or in a corner; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, retro, bohemian
Materials: glazed speckled ceramic, natural bamboo stand
Colors: warm red, orange, peach, terracotta, light natural wood
Shape: cylindrical pot with wide horizontal stripes, raised on a low cross-shaped stand with arched legs, medium size, sturdy
Feel: warm, cheerful, playful
Goes with: light wood, white or cream walls, warm textiles; mid-century or bohemian rooms

Type: galvanized metal milk jug vase
Use: holding dried or fresh stems, plants; on the floor, a console or a hearth; living room, dining room, entryway
Style: farmhouse, rustic
Materials: galvanized metal with aged patina, wooden handle grips, wire handles
Colors: cool light grey, rusty brown trim, light natural wood
Shape: vintage milk can outline, flared mouth, sloped shoulders, panelled body, two side handles, medium and solid
Feel: rustic, nostalgic, homey
Goes with: reclaimed wood, white shiplap, cream linens; farmhouse or rustic rooms

Type: hanging railing planter, set of two
Use: growing flowers or herbs; hung over a deck or balcony railing; outdoors, patio
Style: rustic, farmhouse
Materials: recycled wood box, black plastic liner, black metal hooks
Colors: warm reddish-brown wood, black
Shape: long trough with tapered sides, removable liner, two tall hooked brackets, compact and low
Feel: warm, natural, practical
Goes with: wooden decks, black railings, green plants; rustic outdoor spaces

Type: stoneware cylinder planter
Use: holding an indoor plant; on the floor, a shelf or a side table; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: glazed stoneware with brushed streaked texture
Colors: dark grey-green, cream rim and interior
Shape: straight-sided cylinder with fine horizontal brushstroke lines, recessed base, medium size, simple
Feel: calm, earthy, understated
Goes with: warm wood, white walls, green plants, neutral textiles; mid-century or modern rooms

Type: embossed ceramic planter
Use: holding a small indoor plant; on a shelf, windowsill or side table; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: matte glazed ceramic, embossed floral relief, ribbed interior
Colors: soft warm white, light beige interior
Shape: rounded cup shape with gently curved base, all-over medallion flower pattern, small to medium
Feel: soft, light, delicate
Goes with: light wood, rattan, cream and beige textiles; Scandinavian or boho rooms

Type: crosshatch stoneware planter
Use: holding an indoor plant; on a shelf, desk or side table; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: contemporary, glam, modern
Materials: stoneware with metallic crosshatch textured finish, black glazed interior
Colors: cool silver, black
Shape: straight cylinder with fine woven-look scratched texture, small to medium, clean outline
Feel: polished, cool, sleek
Goes with: grey, white and black palettes, glass and chrome; modern or glam rooms

Type: wicker planter with trellis
Use: growing climbing plants, privacy screen; patio, balcony, outdoors
Style: contemporary, modern
Materials: woven resin wicker box, black metal trellis panels, plastic liners
Colors: black
Shape: long rectangular box with three inner pots, tall hinged three-panel grid trellis, large and upright
Feel: tidy, graphic, practical
Goes with: green climbers, grey decking, black outdoor furniture; modern patios

Type: small embossed ceramic planter
Use: holding a small plant or succulent; on a shelf, windowsill or desk; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, art deco, contemporary
Materials: reactive glazed ceramic, embossed fan relief, ribbed unglazed interior
Colors: deep cobalt blue, light blue highlights, cream rim
Shape: rounded cylinder with all-over fan pattern, compact
Feel: vibrant, crafted, lively
Goes with: white walls, light wood, blue and white accents; boho or eclectic rooms

Type: concrete succulent planters, set of three
Use: holding succulents or air plants; on a desk, shelf or windowsill; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: mid-century modern, minimalist, industrial
Materials: cast concrete, gold-tone marbled inlay
Colors: light warm grey, gold
Shape: small cube block with round opening, gold vein streak on one side, compact and solid

Type: two-tone stoneware planter
Use: holding a small indoor plant; on a shelf, desk or windowsill; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: glossy glazed stoneware top, matte bottom band
Colors: white, dark slate grey
Shape: short straight cylinder, color-blocked lower band, small recessed foot, compact
